_comment: Canonical seniority -> per-platform enum. Apollo enum is exact (person_seniorities[]). Prospeo values VERIFIED against the live /search-person API (June 2026): valid Prospeo seniorities are exactly 'C-Suite', 'Director', 'Entry', 'Founder/Owner', 'Head', 'Intern', 'Manager', 'Partner', 'Senior', 'Vice President'.
